messages.content:
Risk: AI-generated security weaknesses
Description: AI system security vulnerabilities: Implementation weaknesses in AI system architecture and infrastructure
Concern: None
Policy: Insider Threat & Cybersecurity

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityIdentifier: security identifier — any publicly available identifier that is used to identify a security [found by 8/10 queries]
  Siblings: unique product identifier, unique swap identifier, universal loan identifier
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 7/10 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 7/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000548: Vulnerability — A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in. [found by 7/10 queries]
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 7/10 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityIdentificationScheme: security identification scheme — formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers [from restriction: isDefinedIn on SecurityIdentifier]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/Security: security — financial instrument that can be bought or sold [from restriction: identifies on SecurityIdentifier]
  Siblings: spot contract, debt instrument, over-the-counter instrument

axes.rationale: The risk specifically mentions 'security vulnerabilities' and 'implementation weaknesses,' which directly relate to the concept of a vulnerability in the context of AI systems.
The risk involves AI-generated content that could introduce security weaknesses, making 'Content Safety Hazard' relevant as it pertains to the potential harmful content generated by AI systems.
